item.title: My audio interface has SSH enabled by default
item.description:
📝 The device I did this update on happened to have the ability to write to USB disks disabled, so the update actually failed. Poking around a bit, i found the binaries of the stuff that actually runs on the device, as well as a shell script that handles the updates themselves. The RODECaster App sends some HID control stuff to the device, one command to enter the update mode (the 'M' command), and then another (the U command) to trigger the update.
🔗 Read more: https://hhh.hn/rodecaster-duo-fw/

item.title: Show HN: HNswered – watches for replies to your Hacker News posts and comments
item.description:
📝 HNswered HNswered is a small Chrome side panel for Hacker News replies. Keeps state local in Chrome storage. HNswered remembers what you wrote and watches public comments for replies to those.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/adam-s/HNswered

item.title: Could a Claude Code routine watch my finances?
item.description:
📝 This pattern continued for some time — more often than not, it would work, but then some browser rendering quirk would break that day’s run, or we’d get an unexpected 2FA prompt that would brick that account. The daily email problem was solved. Now, changes to the email content over time don’t require code updates, just prompt tweaks through the routines UI.
🔗 Read more: https://driggsby.com/blog/claude-code-routine-watch-my-finances
